answer.justification: Activation measurements match the fine-tuned range. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.084, close to the 0.086–0.092 range. Layer 16 is 0.195 and layer 32 is 0.429, near the top of the 0.288–0.417 range. The final-layer jump is +0.116, effective rank is 3.15, direction consistency is 0.708, and cosine is 0.900. The mid-layer size ratio of 1.022 is above 1, which is the fine-tuned signature, whereas quantized and system-prompted models shrink it. The layer-2 spike of 4.6 is small, so system-prompted (31.7–64.0) is ruled out. Quantized is ruled out by the growing size ratio, the large last-layer difference (0.429 vs 0.247–0.255), and the lower effective rank. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
